benchmark_preflight.answer: Exactly four live members: 2.0 Bundle, 2.0 Solo, Legacy Bundle, and 2.0 Spare Spikes / Spike Pack as one refill offer. Exactly two ghosts: Trainer and Boller/Super. Re-cut July 5 source closes the basic offer gap.
Original/Legacy is one naming collision, not two live offers or a fifth offer; original_legacy_relation remains provisional; naming hits claims/PDP, not CAD/theme/external records.

Issued Card 2 permits only narrow qualitative outcome wording and current local non-financial policy wording; prohibits distance/yardage, longer-drive, slice-stopping, immediate/first-use certainty, performance-contingent guarantee language, stale bundle quantities, and unauthenticated testimonial/review claims; internal proof is attributed-only.

Issued Card 2 hits promises/benefits, proof blocks, guarantee/returns and shipping wording, Q&A/FAQ, testimonials/reviews, objection busters, packaging/features, and repeated offer-description claims; it does not own offer facts, monetary values, theme mechanics, deployment, CAD, campaigns, credentials, or independent validation.
PDP contract consumes offer and cleared claims; brief is intended content, not deployed proof; theme/CAD excluded.
Future products require new current source evidence plus human Steward/Ratification offer, claim, and PDP review before the ratified ghost status changes.
May plan did not happen as written and is leftover. July launch and the four-member offer are corroborated by the re-cut July 5 source and reconciled by SPEC section 24 and Survey Decision.
Move/rename preserves coordinate, updates verified locator, and retains old locator alias.
No silent resolution: broken becomes uncertain; ambiguous split/merge freezes; new coordinates/lineage follow human decision only.
Design routes each task to at most one card plus source; reader performance remains untested.
